title: Resolve harmonic spelling and octave target limits
scope: Determine whether authored harmonic spelling/octave survives any supported GP8 representation beyond kind and fractional fret.
acceptance: Use natural and artificial harmonics with explicit non-default spelling, octave and fractional fret.
Separate contradictory compatibility fret fields from genuinely independent authored information.
Implement only proven target destinations or record narrow target limits with strict assertions; retain all currently supported harmonic kinds.

reproduction.instructions: Use natural and artificial harmonics with explicit non-default spelling, octave and fractional fret.

evidence.detail: Public contract; linked matrix cases are in obligation.
Existing scoped evidence; not proof of all AlphaTab variants.
target-limit: Harmonic kind/fret are supported; legacy harmonic-specific pitch/octave spelling has no retaining target destination.

Verify all supported harmonic kinds and fractional frets with exact wire and independent consumer assertions. Separately exercise non-default legacy Pitch/Octave values and their precise loss report. Check strict rejection for the unsupported spelling pair without weakening the supported kind/fret cases. Reuse existing conformance assertions where complete. Resolve as a scoped target limit when the checklist passes. Do not map harmonic spelling to generic note pitch/octave; reopen implementation only for a distinct harmonic-specific record retained by another consumer.
